Name: Gnash Studio - Stardew Valley Portraits
Author: GnashStudioArt
Description:
Welcome to the Gnash Studio Portraits Overhaul! This mod introduces a fresh and artistic take on the beloved portraits of all the bachelors and bachelorettes in Stardew Valley, redesigned in the unique Gnash Studio art style. Immerse yourself in a vibrant world where each character's portrait is infused with new life, distinct expressions, and a modern aesthetic that adds depth to your Stardew Valley experience.
Current Version Features:
[list]
[*]Complete redesign of all bachelor and bachelorette portraits. For Winter and Summer
[*]Each portrait is crafted to enhance the character's personality and backstory with Gnash Studio's signature artistic flair.
[*]High-resolution images for clearer and more engaging visuals.
[/list]Future Updates:
[list]
[*]Plans to extend the Gnash Studio makeover to all characters in the game, ensuring a cohesive and visually stimulating experience throughout Stardew Valley.
[*]Additional tweaks and improvements based on community feedback.
[/list]
Community and Support:[list]
[*]Follow us on social media for sneak peeks, art reveals, and update announcements. (GnashStudio_art)
[/list]Dive into a more stylized Stardew Valley with the Gnash Studio Portraits Overhaul and experience your favorite game like never before! Whether you're romancing a character or simply enjoying the town's dynamics, these new portraits promise to enrich your adventure with a touch of artistic charm.


How to download:
[list]
[*]Download the png pack called "GnashStudioPortraits"
[*]Make sure you have the required mods installed, most importantly portraiture
[*]Within the portraiture files there is a folder called portraits, drag and drop the unzipped folder into it.
[/list][list]
[*]Then load up modded stardew valley, click M when first talking to a character and select gnashstudioportraits if it is not already auto selected!
[/list]
HOPE YOU ENJOY!!!! Any problems send me a message on here or any socials and I will try my best to fix it!
